entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand Cadence Sensor you sold me is a piece of garbage! The pulse reading is completely wrong. I want my money back.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with the device. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the pulse sensor, or is it more of a preference issue?
Are you listening? I said it's garbage! It's a technical fault. It doesn't work. I don't have time to play games, I just want money back. A full refund.

I understand your frustration, and I want to get this sorted out. For a defect claim, my first step is to quickly run through a couple of troubleshooting checks. It will only take a moment and might resolve the issue.

No! Absolutely not. I'm not doing your job for you. I bought a working product, not a project. I don't have time for this nonsense. Are you going to process my refund or do I need to speak to your manager right now? I'm one click away from telling everyone on social media how VeloFit sells broken junk.
Okay, sir, I understand. No need for that. Please allow me just one moment to pull up your account and review our return policy.
Alright, I have your order details here. I'm just checking our internal knowledge base... okay. It looks like our policy states that items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
I can see you received the VeloBand 17 days ago, so you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for you for a full refund. My apologies for the trouble.
Finally. See how easy that was? Yes, do that. Send me the return label.

Of course. I've just initiated the return. You will receive a prepaid shipping label in your email within the next 5-10 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a better rest of your day.
